business_summary: Shenzhen Glory Medical Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells medical products in China and internationally. The company offers medical and protective consumables, including sterile disposable surgical packs, disposable surgical gowns and rapes, isolation and sterile gowns, lab coats, caps, sleeves, boot covers, workwear, face masks, blown and laminated films, spunlace and hot-melt adhesive laminated nonwovens, hand towels, and medical sterilization pouches; and orthopedic consumables, such as orthopedic surgery implants, surgical instruments, spinal trauma internal fixation, locking plate and screw systems, metal bone plates and screws, and intramedullary nails. It also provides medical gas systems comprising gas source station, pipeline and distribution, and ward terminal systems; medical logistics support equipment consisting of isolated power cabinets, distribution boxes, and ventilation and deodorization equipment; digital sterile operating room systems, including operating tables, shadowless lamps, and digital systems; and imaging equipment, such as digital radiography, fluoroscopy, and mammography systems. In addition, the company is involved in professional hospital digital solutions; EPC general contracting services for hospital construction; medical professional department construction services; hospital logistics management services; investment and operation of health industry parks; incubation, cultivation, investment, and merger of medical and health industry enterprises; and medical and community care services. Further, it engages in hospital planning, design, and consulting; specialized medical engineering; medical software development; and hospital investment activities. The company serves general and specialized hospitals. The company was formerly known as Glory Medical Facilities Co., Ltd and changed its name to Shenzhen Glory Medical Co.,Ltd. in 2002. Shenzhen Glory Medical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
